notes.title: Bug after you report and how to tracking your bug
notes.content:
Hi guy !

Thank you guys have reported Error to me by pressing F2  , This things help me a lot to continuously improve Windy kingdom for the better in the future . Just free to write in report board by the language you are using, I can understand what you are trying to say, no need to write by English.

After you press F2 to report the bug to me, your screenshots and bugs will be uploaded to Trello and you can track them here:

https://trello.com/b/ShNz9H7h/windy-kingdom-feedback-board

This is the image when you go the Trello tracking bug

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35153241/7bdd583f7de07937de521f7b9be14a35dc58d866.png[/img]

Depending on how you set up in the game's report, it will display in one of the [b]Feedback [/b]or [b]Bugs [/b]columns

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35153241/e4dfdc3644bbe1881662554f6c0650652d616c9c.png[/img]

[b][u]2 First columns (for users of the report)[/u][/b]

- [b]Feedback :[/b] Where you would like to comment on DEV to improve the feature or create new feature 

- [b]Bugs : [/b]Where to report bugs in game

[b][u]4 columns remaining  ( for DEV )[/u][/b]

-[b]Resolved :[/b] This column contains the fixed bugs . 

-[b]Checked and being processed:[/b] This column is where the errors are in the process of being resolved

-[b]The cause has not been found :[/b] This column contains errors that cannot find the cause , Need gamers contact me to solve, the way to contact me write in the section below.

-[b]This is not a Bug :[/b] This column contains reports that have been misinterpreted as errors . I have a comment below the report so user can read .

-[b]Change logs :[/b]This column to checks the version and the bugs fixed in that version


I will prioritize fixing important make player can not be continue play first. Unimportant errors will be supported later . The bug fix version may be updated continuously once a day or twice. I will fix the error very quickly then upload it , so as not to interrupt your experience.

There are errors that need to check your game save file, you can send me save game files via 
email :info@eastfog.com . 
File save game will be in the folder:
C:\Users\Admin\AppData\LocalLow\EastFog\Windy Kingdom
Inside this folder there may be screenshots that you reported error to me earlier. You can delete it because these pictures are already stored on Trello
(Note: Only delete the image file, do not delete the files .Eastfog because it is your save game)


[u][b]How to contact DEV:[/b][/u]
current this game  fixed by one person, so it was impossible to speed up the process. Some error very complicated , that take a long time to fix and there are errors I cannot find the cause and need to contact the gamer to ask . So if anyone wants to report it directly to me in the following way:

Steam : https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198066172796/
Discord : https://discord.gg/YMS3pty
Email : info@eastfog.com

Thank you !

notes.title: Update Version 5.0
notes.content:
Hello friends

[h1]In version 4.0[/h1]

I solved the issue loading time 

Time load game version 4.0 : 1 minute ( with HDD )
[b]New VGA : [/b]
Tested VGA 1060 6G : ~ 90 FPS 
[b]Old VGA:[/b]
Tested AMD Radeon HD 6670 1Gb : ~5-10 FPS [b](Very lag)[/b]

[b]( Game load times have been improved, but with older graphics cards, the FPS is too low , 5-10 FPS can't play the game )[/b]

To improve this issue to improve this issue in version 5.0

[h1]In version 5.0[/h1]

Time load game version 5.0 : 2 minute 10 seconds ( with HDD )
[b]New VGA : [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35153241/be42c86d2e2546345c461e5e77294da8d9e578a5.png[/img]

Tested VGA 1060 6G : 154 FPS (in house)  - and 119 FPS ( in farm )

[b]Old VGA:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35153241/2fbe70468452f55a3477eb5abdbeda0c6f3ce617.png[/img]
Tested AMD Radeon HD 6670 1Gb : 43 FPS (in house)  - and 32 FPS (in farm)

[b]( Game load time increased, but the graphics card's FPS was resolved... low-profile computers now can play games  , With 1 GB VGA , the FPS will reach ~ 40 FPS, the gaming experience can be good. )[/b]

This version 5.0 hoping you can accept that the load times will increase but the FPS will improve , In the future I will continue to find solutions to improve the loading times.

If you have any feedback on this change , please click to button [b]discuss [/b]below

Thank you !

notes.title: Update Version 4.4 open the desert map and Lama animal
notes.content:
Hi everybody 

Currently, Windy kingdom has come to version 4.4. There have been a lot of bugs that have been fixed since version 2.0 . 
I got quite a lot of errors that you guys sent me by pressing F2 in the game, but also some one the crack version play and send bugs to us. I'm not sad when you using the crack version.
I just want to say : a lot of bugs in the old version that you guys have been fixed.
I hope you can play the new version to have the best experience

[h1]Here are the new updates in version 4.4
[/h1]

[h2]Crafting a Bom[/h2]
You can craft a bomb inside the craft item panel

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35153241/7618fe798773895a08eee0895c840950c07db478.png[/img]

Hold it in your hand then click or Space to place the bomb

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35153241/f5fa516988a3dc104b34a124941005e8c1cf627a.png[/img]

You need to keep your distance to avoid the explosion causing you injury

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35153241/a9c757d10d597e4af5d7b8f55b51c731541a580d.png[/img]

[h2]Open the path to the desert map [/h2]

Going to end of the castle will have a path blocked, you need to drag and drop the bomb to unlock the road

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35153241/6a1ada8bec2b980b25d4461b87dafc0a55abb001.png[/img]

Inside the desert map will require you to reach Lv50 (the desert map is not completed yet, I will continue to improve it in the future)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35153241/2f89bb152f8ebd2293595526c78fc500aa1bdd82.png[/img]

[h2] Fix lama barn [/h2]
You will need to fix the lama's barn before you can keep them , Their barn is located opposite the Farm Market
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35153241/9a2f3d9a8e6b54c8a01c749aeb2325aa4189c37f.png[/img]


[h2]Use the lama to transport items [/h2]

You can then go to Yuriko's Shop to buy Lama priced at: 5000
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35153241/05e42b8c30506db8b7920fba5725495cd0b12d67.png[/img]

Drag and drop the lama into the barn and you will have a lama to use to transport the items
You can click [b](Bell icon)[/b] to call it follow you or click [b](Home icon) [/b]to bring it home

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35153241/8f8da1c347a6c26e2bbe01c0a1d39f79df6f5805.png[/img]

You can expand to 20 more cells to contains Items in bag of lama

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35153241/b2ae6b984231e4a149b1516ba0819d4cb712186b.png[/img]

Hope you have fun in this update. I will continue to update more in the future

Thank you

notes.title: Bugs and How to report a Bug
notes.content:
[b]Hi Guys,[/b]

Before starting the game , please determine that Windy kingdom is an open world game. You are free to do everything in the game , so it will definitely have more bugs than other games with linear gameplay.. Please determine that game content will be continuously updated so after you buy the game the value of the game will always increase compared to the present time.
At the beginning when the game release have a lot of Bugs and it will gradually disappear in the future. When you meet Bug in the game don't get angry , Just Send it to me, I will take care of it all
There are 2 ways you can report the Bugs

[h1]Option 1: [/h1]
If you encounter a bug that keeps causing Crash game or can't continue playing game
eg: Black screen forever or character falling forever
This is a serious bug you can go to discord and chat directly with me, I will fix it soon.

Link Discord : https://discord.com/invite/YMS3pty
Email : Info@eastfog.com

[h1]Option 2:[/h1]
If you encounter a non-fatal error, but it makes you feel inconvenient or annoyed
Simply press F2 to report the error to the Eastfog server. I encourage you to do it this way, because it will capture your gaming screen atthat moment. This helps me a lot , I can see where you are experiencing the errors and how to fix them

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35153241/eb0e60fdafb310b85b8608f34da2bcd5ceac4573.png[/img]

Don't forget to write a [b]description [/b]of the error so I know what the bug you got . You no need to write English just write the language you use, I can understand what you are saying
The submission process will take some time because depending on your screen resolution, the image file will be Big or small.

All images and save game will be saved in Folder:
\AppData\LocalLow\EastFog\Windy Kingdom
You can go there to clean up your saved image files
Also you can feedback your opinion directly by writing on it ... I will always read everything your feedback

I will always listen to you to make Windy Kingdom more and more perfect

Thank you guys!

notes.title: Early Access Release
notes.content:
Hello Guy ,

After a long time developing the Windy kingdom project, we decided to release the Early Access version on August 11, 2020.

It's been 4 years since I finished developing the Root Of Evil: The Tailor project, I quickly started a new challenge called : Windy kingdom. The project is conducted with 2 people, although with limited resources but we always try to give you the best experience when playing the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35153241/a73f05dc00c3bfeac40a59ff8623576798c9680f.png[/img]

With a nice graphics and attractive gameplay , I believe you will time fun and relax with Windy kingdom. The project in the Early Access period so , there is still a lot of work to do in front. We hope you will continue to support us in this difficult and challenging journey.

The current Early Access version will support 3 languages: English - Chinese - Vietnamese. Other languages will be supported in the future
If you want Windy kingdom support your language soon, Please check here:

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1096560/discussions/0/2799503175294190385/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35153241/51685abe3aa31ecb1feb5fda53b1751724cb06b4.png[/img][/url]

Or go to this link:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1096560/discussions/0/2799503175294190385/

Windy kingdom in Early Access version has almost 80% of the features in the game
Farming – Fighting monsters – Crafting – Discover – Survival
In the future , we will improve the interaction with the NPC , Boss and game's story
Estimated price of Early Access version is $ 14.99.
We will offer a discount within 1 weeks of the release date.
Let's quickly buy the game this week because the law of steam we will have to wait 6 weeks for a next discount
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1096560/Windy_Kingdom/

If you do not have enough money to buy the game right now, do not worry, just add the game to your wishlist and wait for the next discount.
Hope you will support us in the future.

Any contact information you can send back : info@Eastfog.com
Facebook : https://www.facebook.com/eastfog/
Twitter : https://twitter.com/EastFog_Studios
For any game discussions you can use the Community Hub or on our Server Discord
Community Hub : https://steamcommunity.com/app/1096560/discussions/
Discord : https://discord.gg/YMS3pty

Thank you so much !
